tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /skabs bzhi pa'i ṭikka legs par bshad pa'i snying po bsdus pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/

rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnyis pa sbyor bzhi rgyas par bshad pa la sbyor bzhi'i dang po rgyu rnams rdzogs sbyor ba 'chad pa la/ skabs 'dir rnam rdzogs sbyor ba 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ gzhung don dngos bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ mkhyen gsum bshad zin pa'i 'og tu sbyor bzhi'i dang po rnam rdzogs sbyor ba 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa la goms pa dbang du bya ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir te/ 'grel pa las/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum yongs su shes pa nyid dbang du bya ba'i phyir yang rnam pa thams cad dang lam dang gzhi shes pa bsdu ba'i sgo nas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum sgom par byed pas/ rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs pa rtogs pa/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba spyi'i rnam gzhag dang*/ thar pa cha 'thun nas bzung ste rgyud la skye pa'i rim pa bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ sbyor ba'i ngo bo/ sbyor ba'i skyon yon/ sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ mi mthun phyogs kyi gnyen po rnam pa'i bye brag bshad pa dang*/ bden 'dzin dngos su 'joms par byed pa'i sbyor pa khyad par can ngos bzung ba gnyis/ dang po la/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzhi shes pa yi bye brag rnams/ /zhes pa nas/ rnam pa zhes bya mtshan nyid de/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ gzhi bden bzhi mi rtag la sogs bcu drug shes pa yi ye shes kyi bye brag gam khyad bar rnams ni rang gi mi mthun phyogs de dang de'i yul gyi zlog phyogs kyi rnam pa shar pa'i sgo nas de dag 'joms par byed pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes zhes bya ba chos can/ skabs 'dir gtso bor bstan pa'i gnyen po'i mtshan nyid ces bya bar brjod de/ de'i 'jog byed yin pa'i phyir/ gnyen po'i ye shes kyi rnam pa de chos can/ rigs bsdu na rnam pa gsum du 'dod pa yin te/

bsgom bya kun mkhyen nyid kyi ni rnam pa gsum du nges pa'i phyir/ don ni yid ltar du 'gyur ba yin te/ phung po mi rtag par rtogs pa la sogs pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes chos can/ phung po rtag 'dzin la sogs pa'i gnyen po yin te/ de rnams kyi zhen yul gyi zlog phyogs mi rtag pa la sogs pa'i rnam pa legs par shar ba'i sgo nas de dag dngos su gnod byed kyi sems dpa'i ye shes yin pas so zhes pa'i don yin pa'i phyir/ skabs 'dir rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i bsgom bya don rnam dang shes rnam gnyis bstan pa yin te/ bden gzhi mi rtag la sogs bcu drug po de don rnam dang*/ de rtogs pa'i ye shes rnams shes rnam du bstan pa'i phyir don rnam dang shes rnam gnyis ka bsgom bya yin kyang bsgom bya bsgom byed sgom pa po gsum du phye ba'i tshe gzung rnam bsgom byed dang*/ don rnam bsgom bya dang*/ rten gyi gang zag sgom pa por 'gyur pa yin te bya byed las gsum gyi rnam gzhag 'thad pa'i phyir/ shes rnam yin na bsgom bya yin pas ma khyab ste/ nyon mongs phyogs kyi shes rnam rnams bsgom bya ma yin pa'i phyir te/ dug gsum sgom pa la dgos pa med pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du don rnam la yang bsgom byas ma khyab ste/ shes rnam thams cad kyang don rnam yin pa'i phyir te rtogs bya yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la/ gzhi shes kyi/ lam shes kyi/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ med pa'i rnam pa nas bzung ste/ zhes pa nas/ lam la de ni bco lngar bshad/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ yum bar ma las shes phyin 'di ni ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o zhes sdug bsngal rtag par med pa'i rnam pa ston pa nas bzung ste/ sher phyin 'di mi g.yo ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o zhes lam bden gyi mi g.yo ba yi rnam pa'i bar ston pa'i mdo tshig 'di chos can/

khyod kyis gzhi shes gyi rnam pa nyer bdun bstan pa yin te/ bden pa dang po gsum so so la dmigs pa'i gzhi shes kyi rnam pa bzhi bzhi dang*/ lam bden la dmigs pa'i gzhi shes kyi rnam pa de ni bco lngar bshad pa'i phyir/ sdug bden la dmigs pa bzhi yod de/ sdug bsngal rtag par med pa dang*/ don dam par mi skye ba dang*/ don gzhan gyis stong pa dang*/ rang gi ngo bor gyur pa'i bdag gis mi brdzi ba dang bzhi mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i byang sems kyi gzhi shes kyi rnam pa bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ kun 'byung la dmigs pa bzhi yod de/ sred pa don dam par gnas med pa dang*/ kun 'byung don dam par nam mkha' dang 'dra ba dang*/ rtog dpyod don dam par brjod du med pa dang*/ sred tshor don dam par ming med pa dang bzhi mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sgo nas bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ 'gog bden la dmigs pa bzhi yod de/ 'gog pa don dam par 'gro ba med pa dang*/ zhi ba rkyen gyis mi 'phrog pa dang*/ gya nom pa'i thar pa mi zad pa dang*/ nges 'byung skye ba med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sgo nas bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ lam bden la rnam pa bco lnga yod de/ byed pa po dang*/ shes pa po dang*/ gnas nas 'pho ba po dang*/ nyon mongs 'dul ba po'i gang zag gi bdag med pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi mthong lam bzhi dang*/ phyi don ngo bo nyid med pa dang*/ ma skyes pa dang*/ ma 'gag pa dang*/ bzod ma nas zhi ba dang*/ rang bzhin gyis yongs su mya ngan las 'das par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi sgom lam lnga dang*/ phyi rol don gyi kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa dang*/ rnam par byang ba med pa dang*/ bag chags kyis ma gos pa dang*/ dbye ba'i spros pa med pa dang*/ rlom pa'i zhen pa med pa dang*/ mi g.yo ba'i gzung bya don gzhan med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi mthong lam drug yod pa'i phyir/

phyi ma bsdoms na bcwo lnga yin te/ nyon sgrib kyi gnyen po mthong lam zag med bzhi/ shes sgrib gzung rtog gi gnyen po sgom lam zag bcas lnga/ de'i gnyen po mthong lam zag med drug yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa lam shes kyi rnam pa ni/ rgyu dang lam dang sdug bsngal dang*/ / zhes pa nas/ lnga dang bcu drug ces bsgrags so/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/ lam shes kyi rnam pa de la sum cu rtsa drug yod de/ rgyu kun 'byung dang lam bden dang 'bras bu sdug bsngal dang 'gog pa'i bden pa la ni go rim bzhin du sbyar na/ kun 'byung bden pa la rnam pa de dag brgyad dang*/ lam bden la bdun dang*/ sdug bsngal bden pa la lnga dang*/ 'gog bden la dmigs pa bcu drug yod ces yum gyi mdo las bshad cing bsgrags pa yin pa'i phyir/ kun 'byung la dmigs pa brgyad yod de/ rgyu'i rnam pa yul la 'dun pa'i sred pa dang*/ 'dod chags kyi sred pa dang*/ yang srid la dga' ba gsum gyi gnyen po byang sems kyi mthong lam gsum/ kun 'byung gi rnam pa 'dod chags dang*/ zhe sdang dang*/ gti mug gsum gyi gnyen po byang sems kyi mthong lam gsum/ rab skye'i rnam pa gtsang bde rtag bdag tu 'dzin pa'i gnyen po byang sems kyi mthong lam gcig /rkyen gyi rnam pa rang dbang ba'i sems can du zhen pa'i gnyen po byang sems kyi mthong lam gcig ste brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ lam bden la bdun yod de/ lam gyi rnam pa la sems can tshad med pa la thar pa'i go skabs 'byed pa dang*/ 'khor 'das kyi mtha' gnyis dang ma 'brel par byed pa'i mthong lam gnyis/ rigs pa'i rnam pa la chos thams cad bden stong du tha mi dad par rtogs pa dang*/ nyan rang gi lam mchog tu mi 'dzin pa'i mthong lam gnyis/ sgrub pa'i rnam pa la chos thams cad don dam par rnam par mi rtog pa dang*/ gzhal du med par rtogs pa'i mthong lam gnyis/

nges 'byin gyi rnam pa la chos thams cad don dam par chags pa med pa'i rnam pa can gyi mthong lam gcig rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ sdug bden la lnga yod de/ phung po mi rtag pa dang*/ sdug bsngal ba dang*/ stong ba dang*/ bdag med pa dang*/ don dam par mtshan nyid med par rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi lam shes kyi rnam pa dang lnga yod pa'i phyir/ 'gog bden la dmigs pa bcu drug yod de/ 'gog pa'i rnam pa la nang dang phyi dang gnyis ka'i chos la bden zhen ci rigs spangs pa'i nang dang phyi dang phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa gsum rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi lam shes gsum dang*/ de bzhin du zhi ba'i rnam pa la stong pa nyid dang*/ chen po dang*/ don dam pa dang*/ 'dus byas dang*/ 'dus ma byas dang*/ mtha' las 'das pa dang*/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa dang*/ dor ba med pa stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa brgyad rtogs pa'i lam shes brgyad/ gya nom pa'i rnam pa la rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa rtogs pa'i lam shes gcig /nges 'byung gi rnam pa la chos thams cad dang*/ rang gi mtshan nyid dang*/ mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa gsum rtogs pa'i lam shes gsum/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa rtogs pa'i lam shes kyi rnam pa gcig rnams su yod pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa ni/ dran pa nyer gzhag nas bzung ste/ zhes pa nas/ sum cu rtsa dgu dag tu bzhed/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ sher phyin 'di ni dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o zhes sogs kyis dngos su bstan pa'i dran pa nyer bzhag nas bzung ste/ sher phyin 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o zhes pa'i bar gyi mdo las bstan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rnam pa'i mthar thug pa'i shes rnam rnams ni chos can/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa yin te/ chos thams cad mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/

shes bya chos can/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa de la sum cu rtsa bdun dang*/ sum cu rtsa bzhi dang*/ sum cu rtsa dgu dag tu dbye bar mdo las bzhed de/ sde tshan du phye nas slob ma nyan thos dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ sangs rgyas rnams la rim pa bzhin du de ltar bzhag pa'i phyir/ rgyu mtshan yod de/ rnam mkhyen nyid la rigs kyi sgo nas kun mkhyen gsum du phye bas na de'i phyir te/ gang zag de gsum gyi rgyud la lam gyi bden pa mi 'dra ba gsum yod pa'i rjes su mthun par rnam mkhyen nyid la gsum du phye ba yin pa'i phyir/ med pa'i rnam pa nas bzung ste 'di'i bar gyi mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa thams cad bsdoms na brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum du 'gyur te/ 'grel pa las/ rnam pa rnams gcig tu bsdoms na brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum yod do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ nyan thos dang thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa de la so bdun yod de/ dran pa nyer gzhag bzhi/ yang dag spong ba bzhi/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi/ dbang po lnga/ stobs lnga/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun/ 'phags lam yan lag brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ dang po yod de/ lus dran pa nyer bzhag/ tshor ba dran pa nyer bzhag chos dran pa nyer bzhag /sems dran pa nyer bzhag dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yod de/ mi dge ba'i chos skye 'gyur mi skye ba/ skyes zin spong ba/ dge ba'i chos skye 'gyur skyed pa/ skyes zin spel bar byed pa'i yang dag spong pa dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa yod de/ 'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang*/ brtson 'grus dang*/ sems dang*/ dpyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa yod de/ dad pa'i dbang po/ brtson 'grus dang*/ dran pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ shes rab kyi dbang po dang lnga yod pa'i phyir/ lnga pa yod de/ dad pa brtson 'grus dran pa ting nge 'dzin shes rab kyi stobs dang lnga yod pa'i phyir/

drug pa yod de/ dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag de bzhin du sbyar te/ chos rab tu rnam 'byed yang dag brtson 'grus yang dag /dga' ba yang dag shin tu sbyang ba yang dag ting nge 'dzin yang dag btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang bdun yod pa'i phyir/ bdun pa yod de/ der gyur pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba/ yang dag pa'i rtog pa/ yang dag pa'i ngag yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha'/ yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba/ yang dag pa'i rtsol pa/ yang dag pa'i dran pa/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dang thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa de la so bzhi yod de/ rnam thar sgo gsum/ rnam thar brgyad/ snyoms 'jug dgu spong ba'i lam bzhi/ phar phyin bcu yod pa'i phyir/ dang po yod de/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang*/ mtshan ma med pa dang*/ smon pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang gsum yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yod de/ gzugs can gyi rnam thar gsum/ gzugs med kyi rnam thar bzhi/ 'gog pa'i rnam thar gcig ste brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa yod de/ bsam gtan bzhi/ gzugs med bzhi/ 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug gcig dang dgu yod pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa yod de/ bden bzhi bden med du rtogs pa'i ldog chas bar chad med lam gyi ming can bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ lnga pa yod de/ sbyin pa la sogs pa'i phar phyin bcu yod pa'i phyir/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa de la so dgu yod de/ stobs bcu/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi/ so so yang dag pa'i rig pa bzhi/ ma 'dres pa bco brgyad/ de bzhin nyid kyi rnam pa rnam mkhyen kyi rnam pa sogs gsum rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ dang po yod de/ gnas dang gnas min mkhyen pa'i stobs nas/ zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa'i stobs kyi bar bcu yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yod de/ rang don du spangs rtogs phun sum tshogs par dam bcas pa la mi 'jigs pa gnyis dang*/ gzhan don du bar chad dang nges 'byung gi chos dam bcas pa la mi 'jigs pa gnyis te bzhi yod pa'i phyir/

gsum pa yod de/ chos so so yang dag rig pa/ don so so yang dag rig pa/ nges pa'i tshig so so yang dag rig pa/ spobs pa so so yang dag rig pa dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa yod de/ 'khrul pa mi mnga' ba'i ye shes sogs rtogs pa ma 'dres pa drug /'dun pa la sogs pa'i ye shes ma 'dres pa drug sku gsung thugs kyi 'phrin las ma 'dres pa gsum/ dus gsum chags thogs med par mkhyen pa'i ye shes ma 'dres pa gsum ste bco brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ lnga pa yod de/ de bzhin nyid dang rang byung dang sangs rgyas nyid kyi rnam mkhyen kyi rnam pa gsum yod pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa bden 'dzin dngos su 'joms byed kyi sbyor ba khyad par can bshad pa la/ rten gyi gang zag dang*/ sbyor ba bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ sangs rgyas rnams la lhag par byas/ /zhes pa nas/ snod du dam pa rnams bzhed do/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ rgyan kyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya byang sems chos can/ sher phyin 'di nyan pa yi snod yin te/ sngon sangs rgyas rnams la bkur bsti lhag par byas pa dang*/ sangs rgyas de la bsod snyoms 'bul ba sogs dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa dang*/ theg chen gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi mgon dang bcas pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ yum gyi gzhung don blo la len pa dang 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i snod du rung bar dam pa rnams bzhed de/ de'i ched du sangs rgyas grangs med pa bsten pa dang de la don kun 'dri ba dang*/ dris pa'i don sbyin pa dang tshul khrims sogs la tshul bzhin du spyod pas nyams su len par mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzugs la sogs la mi gnas phyir/ /zhes pa nas/ de ni dag pa mtshams dang bcas/ zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/ 'dir bstan ngo bo'i sbyor ba de la lnga yod de/ yul gzugs la sogs pa la don dam par mi gnas pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ yul can de la bden zhen gyis sbyor ba bkag pa'i sbyor ba dang*/

gzhi de yi de bzhin nyid zab par rtogs pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ lam de rnams kyi de bzhin nyid gting dpag dka' bar rtogs pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ rnam pa'i chos de dag gi chos nyid tshad ni med par rtogs pa'i sbyor ba dang bcas pa lnga yod pa'i phyir/ phyir zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di lnga ka la lnga sbyor dgos te/ khyad par de dang de'i sgo nas sbyor ba khyad par can du bzhag par mtshungs pa'i phyir/ rten gyi sgo nas brgyad yod de/ tshogs lam pa'i rgyud kyi tshogs chen yun ring rtogs pa'i sbyor ba/ drod sogs bzhi la rim bzhin du lung bstan pa dang*/ phyir mi ldog pa nyid dang*/ nges par 'byung ba dang*/ bar chad med bcas dang*/ mthong lam la byang chub nye ba dang*/ sa gnyis pa nas bdun pa'i bar la myur du 'tshang rgya ba dang*/ sa brgyad pa la gzhan don gyi sbyor ba 'jog pa'i phyir/ thabs kyi sgo nas sa bzhi yod de/ sa brgyad pa la 'phel med 'grib med dang*/ don dam par chos dang chos min sogs mi mthong ba dang*/ gzugs sogs bsam mi khyab tu mi mthong ba dang*/ gzugs dang gzugs rung sogs de'i mtshan ma dang gsum/ de yi mtshon bya'i ngo bo don dam pa rnam par mi rtogs pa'i ye shes rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ 'bras bu dang dus kyi sbyor ba yod de/ sa dgu pa'i ye shes 'bras bu rin chen sbyin byed dang*/ sa bcu pa'i ye shes de ni rnam par dag pa dus kyi sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams kyi sbyor ba yod de/ yum myur du sgom pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes de sa mtshams dang bcas pa'i sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ 'dir bstan sbyor ba nyi shu yod de/ rang bzhin gyi sbyor ba lnga dang*/ gnas skabs kyi sbyor ba bco lnga yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa sbyor ba'i skyon yon bshad pa la/ yon tan bshad pa dang*/ skyon bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ bdud kyi mthu bcom la sogs pa/ yon tan rnam pa bcu bzhi'o/

zhes gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba bsgom pa'i phan yon ni yon tan rnam pa bcu bzhi yod de/ sbyor ba bsgoms stobs kyis bdud kyi mthu bcom pa dang la sogs pa ste sangs rgyas dgongs shing gzigs pa dang*/ des mngon sum du mdzad pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub la nye ba dang*/ don che ba dang*/ lung bstan pa'i yul la dpyad pa dang*/ zag med kyi yon tan rdzogs par byed pa dang*/ smra ba'i skyes bu chen por 'gyur pa dang*/ bdud kyis mi phyed pa dang*/ nyan rang dang thun mong ma yin pa'i dge rtsa bskyed pa dang*/ gzhan don chen po sgrub pa'i don 'grub pa dang*/ 'bras bu rgya chen po 'dzin pa dang*/ sems can gyi don sgrub pa dang*/ yum nges par 'thob par 'gyur ba'i yon tan rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ skyon ni bcu tshan bzhir bcas pa/ /drug tu nges par rtogs par bya/ /zhes gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/ sbyor ba skye ba dang gnas pa'i skyon zhe drug yod de/ de 'dra'i skyon ni bcu tshan bzhi dang bcas pa'i drug tu nges par rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ de yang yin te/ der gyur pa'i sbyor pa'i 'gal rkyen rang la brten pa nyi shu/ rang gzhan gang rung la brten pa nyer gsum/ gzhan la brten pa gsum dang bcas pa yod pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ yum gyi tshig don tshogs chen pos 'thob pa nas/ bdud kyi las la 'jug pa'i bar nyi shu yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ nyan pa po yum la 'dun kyang 'chad pa po snyoms las kyis nyams pa nas/ 'chad pa po bsod snyoms ster ba'i khyim du 'gro 'dod kyang nyan pa po 'gro mi 'dod pa'i bar nyer gsum yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grub ste/ bdud kyis chos dang gang zag gnyis so sor 'byed pa sogs gsum yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid bshad pa la/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/

gang gi mtshon de mtshon nyid du/ /zhes pa nas/ ngo bo nyid gang mtshon bya yang*/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/ 'dir lam sher phyin gyi rnal 'byor gyi mtshan nyid 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ mtshon byed gang gis lam sher phyin gyi rnal 'byor du mtshon nus pa de de'i mtshon nyid du shes par bya ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ mtshan nyid de chos can/ khyod la yang rnam pa gsum yod de/ mkhyen gsum sbyor ba mtshon byed shes pa'i mtshan nyid dang*/ nyan rang gi sbyor ba las khyad par du 'phags pa'i khyad par gyi mtshan nyid dang*/ gzhan don sgrub pa'i byed las khyad par can dang ldan pa'i byed pa'i mtshan nyid dang gsum yod pa'i phyir/ ngo bo nyid kyi rnal 'byor bcu drug bstan pa la chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ sbyor ba'i ngo bo nyid gang yin pa mtshon bya dang*/ mtshan gzhi yang shes par bya ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ mtshon tshul yod de/ nyon mongs rtags dang mtshan ma dang*/ /zhes sogs kyi skabs 'byung ba ltar nyon mongs rtags sogs kyis dben pa'i sems dpa'i ngo bo nyid kyi rnal 'byor bcu drug po mtshan gzhi/ lam shes phyin gyi rnal 'byor yin par mtshon/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dang snying rje chen po gnyis kyis zin pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes yin pa zhes pa'i tshul gyis mtshon pa'i phyir/ ngo bo nyid kyi rnal 'byor bcu drug po de mtshan gzhi dang*/ mtshon bya dang*/ mtshan nyid gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa yin te/ mtshon par bya bas na mtshon bya dang mtshan gzhi gnyis ka'i ming gis bstan/ mtshon par byed pas na mtshan nyid kyi ming gis bstan pa'i phyir te/ rtsa bar mtshon bya yang zhes yang gi sgra smros pa la dgos pa yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la/ shes mtshan/ khyad mtshan/ byed mtshan/ ngo bo nyid mtshan dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ dang po la/ gzhi shes/ lam shes/ rnam mkhyen sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid dang bzhi/

dang po ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba dang*/ /zhes pa nas/ shes pa'i mtshan nyid bsdus pa yin/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/ 'dir thams cad shes pa nyid kyi skabs kyi shes pa'i mtshan nyid bcu drug tu bsdus nas bstan pa yin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba zhes pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes dang de bzhin du 'jig rten don dam par 'jig pa med pa'i bdag nyid du rtogs pa dang*/ sems can gyi sems kyi spyod pa dang*/ gang zag gi bdag med la sems de bsdus pa dang*/ de las sems phyir bltas pa dang*/ sems can nam mkha' dang 'dra bar mi zad pa yi rnam pa dang*/ sems 'dod chags dang bcas pa sogs te zhe sdang gti mug dang bcas pa dang*/ shugs bstan sems 'dod chags sogs dang bral ba dang*/ sems kyi gnas lugs rgya chen po dang sems sgyu ma ltar snang ba'i chen por gyur pa dang*/ don dam par sems tshad med pa dang*/ sems rnam shes dbang shes kyi ngo bor bstan du med pa dang*/ sems spyan snga ma bltar med pa dang*/ shes pa de la g.yo ba dang la sogs pa 'du ba dang bkram pa dang bcum ba bzhi yod par shes pa zhes bya ba dang*/ shes tshul de las gzhan yang g.yo ba sogs de dag ni rang bzhin bden pas stong ba de bzhin nyid kyi rnam par shes pa dang*/ thub pa'i dbang pos de bzhin nyid rtogs pa de gzhan la bstan pa shes pa zhes bya ba'i sems dpa'i ye shes 'di dang bcu drug yod par bstan pa'i phyir/ bcu drug po de'i sgo nas mtshon tshul yod de/ nyon mongs rtags sogs kyis dben pa'i sems dpa'i ngo bo nyid kyi rnal 'byor bcu drug gi nang mtshan gyi rnal 'byor dang po bzhi mtshan gzhi/ 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i sems dpa'i gzhi shes sbyor ba yin par mtshon/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba sogs yul bcu drug po gang rung rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sgo nas nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes yin pa zhes pa'i tshul gyis mtshon pa'i phyir/

dbye na bcu drug yod de/ zin byed kyi dbye bas de ltar du yod pa'i phyir/ g.yo ba la sogs zhes bya dang*/ zhes sogs kyis lta ngan bcu bzhi bstan pa yin la/ de'i khyad par yod de/ gzhan sde'i rgyud kyi gang zag gi bdag dang 'jig rten rtag par lta ba sogs sngon gyi mtha' la brten pa'i lung ma bstan gyi lta ngan bzhi/ gang zag gi bdag dang 'jig rten mtha' dang ldan pa skye ba phyi mar mi 'jug par lta ba sogs phyi ma'i mtha' la brten pa'i lta ngan bzhi/ grol ba po'i bdag grongs nas de phan chad du 'byung bar lta ba sogs myang 'das kyi mtha' la brten pa'i lta ngan bzhi/ gang zag gi bdag dang phung po rdzas gcig tu lta ba dang tha dad du lta ba'i lung ma bstan gnyis te bcu bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ 'dir bstan lta ngan bcu bzhi po de kun btags yin te/ grub mtha' ngan pas blo bsgyur pa'i dbang gis yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa lam shes sbyor ba ni/ /stong nyid mtshan ma med bcas dang*/ /zhes pa nas/ shes pa'i mtshan nyid ces bshad do/ zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/ sems dpa'i lam shes sbyor ba bcu drug yod de/ lam shes pa'i sher phyin la brten nas ngo bo bden par grub pa'i stong nyid dang*/ rgyu la don dam par mtshan ma med pa dang bcas pa dang*/ 'bras bu la don dam par smon pa rnam par spangs par rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes gsum dang*/ de bzhin du 'dus byas kyi chos thams cad don dam par skye ba med pa dang*/ 'gag pa med pa dang*/ sogs sgras kun nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam par byang ba dang spangs bya'i dngos po dang stong pa'i ngo bo nyid dang rten rnams don dam par med pa dang nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de drug dang*/ chos nyid gzhan du rnam par 'khrug pa med pa dang*/ blo sngon du btang nas 'du mi byed pa dang*/ mtshan nyid dang gzhi'i rab dbye la rnam par mi rtog pa dang*/ mtshan nyid kyi rab tu dbye ba dang*/

don dam par mtshan nyid med pa nyid du rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes dang bcu drug yod pa'i phyir/ shes pa'i mtshan nyid de rnams chos can/ lam shes nyid kyi skabs kyis ni/ bsdus pa yin par bzhed de/ mtshon bya'i sgo nas bsdus pa'i phyir/ mtshon tshul yod de/ gzhan don bya dka' ba sogs sgrub pa'i sems dpa'i ngo bo nyid kyi rnal 'byor bar ba bzhi po mtshan gzhi/ 'dir bstan sems dpa'i lam shes sbyor ba yin par mtshon/ stong nyid mtshan med sogs yul bcu drug po gang rung rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes yin pa zhes pa'i tshul kyis mtshon pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa rnam mkhyen gyi sbyor ba ni/ de ni nyid kyi chos bstan nas/ / zhes pa nas/ shes pa'i mtshan nyid ces bshad do/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/ sems dpa'i rnam mkhyen sbyor ba yod de/ de bzhin gshegs pa de ni/ de nyid kyi chos la brten nas mthong chos la bde bar gnas par rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes dang*/ de bzhin du dge ba'i bshes gnyen la gus par bya ba dang*/ bka' las mi 'da' bar bla ma nyid du bya ba dang*/ rnyed bkur gyis mnyes par bya ba dang*/ bla ma de la mchod par byed pa dang*/ don dam par mchod par byed du med pa dang*/ ye shes kyis shes bya kun tu 'jug par mkhyen pa gang yin pa dang*/ don dam par ma mthong ba'i don ston par mdzad pa dang*/ 'jig rten bden pas stong pa'i stong pa nyid rnam pa shes pa dang*/ 'jig rten bden stong nyid du brjod pa dang*/ de bden stong nyid du shes par mdzad pa dang*/ de ltar mngon sum du mthong bar mdzad pa dang*/ chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyid du ston pa dang*/ don dam par spros pa zhi ba nyid du ston pa dang*/ 'jig rten la bden par 'du shes pa 'gog pa dang*/ 'di dang pha rol la don dam par blang dor gyi 'du shes 'gog pa shes pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes dang bcu drug yod pa'i phyir/

bcu drug pos chos can/ rnam pa kun mkhyen pa'i tshul la ni mi shes pa'i mtshan nyid tu bshad pa yin te/ /sngar bshad pa de ltar yin pa'i phyir/ mtshon tshul yod de/ gzhi lam gyi khyad par la dmigs pa sogs sems dpa'i ngo bo nyid kyi rnal 'byor tha ma bdun po mtshan gzhi/ 'dir bstan pa'i sems dpa'i rnam mkhyen sbyor ba yin par mtshon/ thub pas de bzhin nyid kyi chos rtogs nas mthong chos la bde bar gnas pa sogs yul bcu drug po gang rung rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes yin pa zhes pa'i tshul gyis mtshon pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa khyad mtshan ni/ bsam mi khyab sogs khyad par gyis zhes pa nas/ khyad du 'phags pas khyad par lam/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ /'di la mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ khyad mtshan bcu drug yod de/ sdug bden gyi chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab par thugs su chud pa dang*/ mi mnyam pa la sogs pa'i khyad par gyis bden bzhi'i chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas nyan rang gi sbyor ba las khyad par du zhugs pa'i bden pa'i spyod yul can gyi mthong lam shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug gi dbang gis mtshon byed khyad par kyis mtshan nyid bcu drug tu bshad pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ shes bya chos can/ khyad mtshan la rgyas par dbye na bcu drug yod de/ sdug bden gyi chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ dpes mi mnyam pa dang*/ tha snyad pa'i tshad mas gzhal ba las 'das pa dang*/ grangs kyis bgrang ba las yang dag par 'das pa rtogs pa'i ye shes bzhi dang*/ 'phags pa'i gang zag gi yon tan can sdud pa dang*/ chos thams cad shes pa'i skyes bu mkhas pa yis rig par bya ba nyid dang*/ nyan rang dang thun mong ma yin pa'i dngos po yongs su shes par bya ba nyid dang*/ rang gi mngon par shes pa shin tu myur ba te kun 'byung gi chos nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes bzhi dang*/

chos thams cad don dam par bri ba dang gang ba med pa dang/ phyin drug shugs drag tu sgrub pa dang*/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yang dag par 'grub pa dang*/ thabs kyis zin pa'i rnam par mi rtog pa chos thams cad la dmigs pa ste 'gog pa'i chos nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes bzhi dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i lam gyi rigs la brten pa dang bcas pa dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshogs mtha' dag pa ldan pa dang*/ theg chen gyi lam rdzogs par ston pa'i yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang bcas pa dang*/ chos gang la'ang bden zhen gyis ro myang ba med pa ste lam bden gyi chos nyid rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes bzhi dang bcas pa khyad par gyi ni mtshan nyid bcu drug gi bdag nyid du shes par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ gang gis lam shes dang rnam mkhyen gyi sbyor ba'i lam ni khyad par du 'phags pa'i lam du 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ lam gzhan nyan rang gi lam dag las khyad par du 'phags pa'i sgo nas bzhag pa'i phyir/ de ltar yin te/ lam de sangs rgyas legs par sgrub pa'i shes rab khyad par can sngar bshad pa de dag gis zin pa yin pa'i phyir/ mtshon tshul yod de/ nyon mongs rtags sogs kyis dben pa'i sems dpa'i ngo bo nyid kyi rnal 'byor bcu drug po mtshan gzhi/ 'dir bstan dman pa'i sbyor ba las khyad par du 'phags pa'i sems dpa'i sbyor ba yin par mtshon/ sdug bden gyi chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa sogs yul bcu drug po gang rung rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes yin pa zhes pa'i tshul gyis mtshon pa'i phyir/ sems dpa'i gzhi shes sbyor ba de/ dman pa'i sbyor ba las khyad par du 'phags kyang skabs 'dir dngos su de las 'phags par mi ston pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ gzhi shes sbyor ba nyan rang la'ang yod pas de ltar ma bstan pa'i phyir/ gsum pa byed mtshan ni/

phan dang bde dang skyob pa dang*/ /zhes pa nas/ 'di ni byed pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/ byed las khyad par can gyi sems dpa'i sbyor ba bcu gcig yod de/ gzhi shes kyi sbyor ba'i byed pa ma 'ongs pa'i phan pa dang tshe 'di'i bde ba dang*/ sems can sdug bsngal las skyobs pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes gsum dang*/ mi rnams kyis ni skyabs sogs byed pa dag dang*/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu zlog pas gnas dang*/ 'khor 'das don dam par mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pas dpung gnyen dang*/ srid pa'i chu klung las sgrol zhing rang gzhan gyi don rtogs pa'i rten gyi ngo bo gling dang*/ rang gzhan gyi don sgrub pas yongs su 'dren pa zhes bya ba dang*/ don de yang lhun gyis grub par byed pa dang*/ theg pa gsum gyi nges par 'byung ba'i dus ma yin par mngon du mi byed pa'i bdag nyid can gyi sems dpa'i ye shes te lam shes kyi byed pa bdun dang byed pa bcu gcig gi tha ma rnam mkhyen gyi sbyor ba ni sems can gyi rten gyi mdzad pa gcig ste bcu gcig po 'di ni byed pa'i mtshan nyid dam rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ mtshon tshul yod de/ nyon mongs rtags sogs kyis dben pa'i sems dpa'i ngo bo nyid kyi rnal 'byor bcu drug po mtshan gzhi/ 'dir bstan gzhan don rgya chen po sgrub pa'i byed las khyad par can gyi sems dpa'i sbyor ba yin par mtshon/ phan bde skyob pa sogs byed las bcu gcig po ci rigs dang ldan pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes yin pa zhes pa'i tshul gyis mtshon pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ngo bo nyid mtshan ni/ nyon mongs rtags dang mtshan ma dang*/ / zhes pa nas/ mtshan nyid bzhi par bzhed pa yin/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/ sems dpa'i ngo bo nyid kyi rnal 'byor bcu drug yod de/ 'dod chags sogs nyon mongs pa spong pa dang*/ de'i rtags lus kyi gnas ngan len spong ba dang*/

de'i rgyu mtshan ma tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pa med pa dang*/ chags sogs mi mthun phyogs dang de'i gnyen po dag don dam par bdag gis dben par rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i gzhi shes sbyor pa'i ngo bo nyid bzhi dang*/ don dam bar med pa'i sems can mtha' yas pa mya ngan las bzla ba'i gzhan don bya dka' ba sgrub pa dang*/ theg pa gzhan du mi ltung bar 'tshang rgya bar nges pa sgrub pa dang*/ ched du bya ba chen po gsum sgrub pa dang*/ bsgom bya dang bsgom pa po'i chos don dam par mi dmigs par rtogs pa dang*/ dngos po la bden par mngon par zhen pa bkag pa'i sems dpa'i lam shes sbyor ba'i ngo bo nyid lnga dang*/ gzhi shes dang lam shes kyi khyad par la dmigs pa zhes bya ba gang yin pa dang*/ byis pa 'dzin pa mi mthun pa dngos po dang dngos med la bden zhen med pa dang*/ gzugs sogs kyi chos rnams thogs pa med par shes pa dang*/ shes bya gzugs sogs de rnams don dam par med pas 'khrul gzhi bden par med par shes pa dang*/ don dam par gang du 'gro ba med pa dang*/ don dam par skye ba med pa dang*/ dngos po dang dngos med dang gnyis ka'i de bzhin nyin ni don dam par dmigs par rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i rnam mkhyen sbyor ba bdun dang bcas pa ngo bo nyid kyi rnal 'byor bcu drug gi bdag nyid rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ bcu drug po de chos can/ mtshan nyid bzhi pa ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan nyid yin par bzhed pa yin te/ khyod kyis me dang tsha ba ltar mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba sngar bshad pa de dag rang gi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i mtshon bya lta bur mtshon par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid kyi grangs bsdoms na go gcig tu 'gyur ro/ /'dir mtshon bya dang mtshan nyid kyi tha snyad ni bya byed gnyis ka dang 'dra 'brel ba'i dbang gis yin gyis/ mtshon bya dang mtshan nyid dngos yin pa'i dbang du byas pa ni min te/

rnal 'byor tha ma bcu drug po la mtshan mtshon gnyis ka'i tha snyad mdzad kyang de gnyis ka yin pa mi srid pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa thar pa cha 'thun nas bzung ste rgyud la skye ba'i rim pa bshad pa la/ grangs med gsum nas 'tshang rgya ba'i lam gyi thog ma ngos bzung pa'i sgo nas rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya ngos bzung ba/ rgyud smin byed kyi lam gyi rim pa/ mngon rtogs khyad par rgyud la skye ba'i rim pa bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ lam spyi'i mtshan nyid dang*/ lam gyi chings lngar bsdus nas de la mkhas par bshad pa dang gnyis/ dang po ni/ mtshan med rab tu sbyin la sogs/ /zhes pa nas/ thar pa'i cha dang 'thun par 'dod/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi ched du bya pa'i gdul bya'i rgyud kyi stong nyid rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi tshogs lam ni chos can/ rnam pa thams cad mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa'i skabs 'di'ang thar ba'i cha dang 'thun pa yin par 'dod de/ don dam par mtshan ma med par rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i rab tu sbyin pa la sogs pa nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar rang rgyud la yang dag par sgrub bcas la mkhas pa'i theg chen gyi chos mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas sogs dmigs dad pa dang*/ /zhes pa nas/ rtogs sla rtul pos rtogs dkar bzhed/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/ 'di la lam gyi chings dang*/ de la mkhas pa'i gdul bya ngos bzung ba gnyis/ dang po'i don ni/ shes bya chos can/ theg chen gyi rigs can theg chen lam du zhugs nas spyod pa gang la slob tshul yod de/ sangs rgyas sogs la dmigs pa'i dad pa dang*/ sbyin sogs phar phyin drug spyod yul du byed pa'i brtson 'grus dang*/ theg chen lam gyi 'jug sgo bsam pa phun tshogs byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas de'i grogs rnam mkhyen yang yang dran pa'i dran pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs dmigs yul du byas pa'i rnam par mi rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/

chos rnams rnam pa thams cad du shes pa'i shes rab rnam pa lnga la slob dgos pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya de la nang ses kyi dbang po'i rim pa gnyis su yod de/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub ni dbang po rnon po yis rtogs pa ste thob sla la/ de la ltos nas dbang po rtul pos rtogs pa ste thob dka' bar bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /theg chen gyi tshogs lam yin na/ dad sogs yul lnga la mkhas pas ma khyab ste/ bden 'dzin gyis bcings pa'i theg chen gyi tshogs lam yod pa'i phyir/ de yin na bskal ba grangs med gsum nas 'tshang rgya ba'i lam gyi thog ma yin pas kyang ma khyab ste/ sems bskyed nas bskal ba grangs med so gsum nas 'tshang rgya ba yang srid pa'i phyir ro/ /rtul pos rtogs dka' bzhed ces pa'i dngos bstan gyi dbang rtul la dbang rtul gyis ma khyab ste/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya dbang rtul de dbang rtul ma yin pa'i phyir te/ dbang rnon yin pa'i phyir/ de'i ched du bya ba'i gdul bya yin pa'i phyir/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul byas rgyan la brten nas lam bgrod tshul yang shes dgos te/ bsdu na thog mar skabs dang po nas bstan pa'i rigs sad par byas nas sems bskyed 'dir bstan pa'i tshogs lam rang rgyud la bskyed dgos/ de nas dro ba rnams kyi zhes sogs kyi skabs dang de'i gong nas bstan pa'i sbyor lam dang*/ skabs dang po gsum dang*/ lnga pa'i skabs nas bstan pa'i sbyor lam rang rgyud la bskyed dgos/ de nas skabs gnyis pa'i bden dang bden la sogs dang*/ skabs gsum pa'i gzugs rtag ma yin zhes sogs dang*/ rtse sbyor dang*/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i skabs nas bstan pa'i mthong lam rang rgyud la bskyed dgos/ de nas skabs gnyis pa dang*/ bzhi pa dang*/ lnga pa'i skabs nas bstan pa'i sgo lam rang rgyud la bskye dgos/

de dag gi tshe skabs 'di nas bshad pa'i phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags thob par byed pa dang*/ go sgrub la sogs pa'i sgrub pa bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su len cing*/ drug pa'i mthar gyis sbyor bas go rim ma 'chol bar sgrub pa dang*/ bdun pa'i skad cig sbyor ba la brten nas brgyad pa'i 'bras bu chos sku thob par byed dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa rgyud smin byed lam nges 'byed cha 'thun ni/ dro ba rnams kyi dmigs pa 'dir/ /zhes pa nas/ smin byed sogs kyis shes par bya /zhes gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod sogs bzhi'i dmigs pa yod de/ dang po sbyor lam dro ba rnams kyi dmigs pa skabs 'dir sems can thams cad yin par yum gyi mdo las bsngags shing brjod pa'i phyir/ tshul ji ltar zhe na yod de/ sems can de dag nyid la dmigs nas sems mnyam par lta ba sogs rnam pa dag ni bcur bshad pa'i phyir/ sbyor lam rtse mor gyur pa'i dmigs pa yod de/ de bzhin du sems can thams cad la dmigs rtse mo ba bdag nyid sdig pa mi dge ba bcu las ldog cing*/ sbyin sogs la gnas pa'i sgo nas sems can gzhan dag de dag la ni 'god pa dang*/ de dag gi bsngags pa brjod pa dang mthun pas dga' bar byed pa nyid kyis dmigs pa'i phyir/ sbyor lam bzod pa'i dmigs pa yod de/ de bzhin du sems can la dmigs nas rang bden pa bzhi shes pa la gnas shing sems can gzhan gyi rten can bden pa shes pa de la 'god pa'i tshul gyis dmigs pa'i phyir/ sbyor lam chos mchog gi dmigs pa yod de/ de bzhin du sems can rnams la dmigs nas smin par byed pa dang grol bar byed pa sogs kyis dmigs par shes par bya ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /sngon gyi dam pa kha cig skabs 'dir bstan pa'i sbyor lam sbyor lam btags pa bar 'dod pa ni mi 'thad de/ skabs gang du yin yang sbyong mthong sgom gsum bstan pa de rnams mtshan nyid pa yin pa'i phyir ro/

/gsum pa mngon rtogs khyad par can rgyud la skye ba'i rim pa bshad pa la/ phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags bshad pa dang*/ sku gsum sgrub byed kyi lam khyad par can bshad pa dang gnyis/ dang po la/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ so sor bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ nges 'byed yan lag nas bzung ste/ /zhes pa nas/ de 'dir phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/ skabs 'dir phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun gyi tshogs rnams pa gsum yod de/ theg chen gyi nges 'byed yan lag la gnas pa'i sems dpa' dbang rnon nas bzung ste/ theg chen gyi mthong ba'i lam dang sgom pa'i lam dag la byang chub sems dpa' gang dag gnas pa de dag rnams su yod pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa so sor bshad pa la/ sbyor lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags/ mthong lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags sgom lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags dang gsum/ dang po la/ mdor bstan dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa dang gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzugs la sogs la ldog sogs rtags/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/ theg chen gyi nges 'byeng yan lag la gnas pa'i dge 'dun gyi phyir mi ldog pa'i mtshan nyid de rtags yod de/ 'chad 'gyur ltar gzugs la sogs pa la bden zhen mngon 'gyur ba ldog pa sogs rtags rnam pa nyi shur brjod pa yis ni shes pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gzugs la sogs las ldog pa dang*/ /zhes pa nas/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub las mi ldog /ces pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ drod sogs bzhi las/ dang po drod kyi rtags bcu gcig yod de/ gzugs la sogs pa'i chos la bden zhen mngon 'gyur ba ci rigs las ldog pa dang*/ skyabs gnas la de yin min gyi the tshom mngon 'gyur ba zad pa dang*/ dal ba ldan pa'i mi dal ba yi khom pa brgyad du skye ba bzang ba dang*/ bdag nyid sby-in sogs dge ba la gnas shing gzhan dag de la 'god pa'i byed pa'i spyod pa dang*/

sems can gzhan gyi rten can bdag gi sbyin sogs kyi 'bras bu la longs spyod par gyur cig pa'i bsngo ba dang*/ stong nyid zab mo'i don la'ang som nyi med pa dang*/ byams pa'i sems kyi lus sogs te ngag dang yid kyi las dang ldan pa dang*/ 'dod pa la 'dun pa dang gnod sems dang gnyid rmugs gnyis dang 'gyod rgod gnyis dang the tshom nyon mongs can gyi sgrib pa ni rnam pa lnga dang mi 'grogs pa dang*/ ma rig pa dang ldan pa'i lta ba ngan pa'i bag la nyal kun 'jom par byed nus pa'i mthu dang ldan pa dang*/ spyod lam thams cad du dran pa dang ni shes bzhin dang ldan pa dang gos la sogs pa yongs su spyad pa gtsang ba zhes bya ba dang bcu gcig yod pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa rtse mo'i rtags drug yod de/ gang zag de'i lus la srin bu'i rigs brgyad khri rnams mi 'byung ba dang*/ rang don yid byed kyi sems gya gyu med pa dang*/ phyag dar khrod pa la sogs pa'i sbyangs pa'i yon tan ni len pa dang*/ sbyin sogs la spyod pa'i tshe ser sna med pa sogs dang ldan pa dang*/ stong nyid gyi chos nyid dang 'gal bar mi byed pa'i sher phyin kyi rnal 'byor dang ldan par 'gro ba dang*/ sems can gzhan gyi don du dmyal bar 'gro bar 'tshol ba'i 'dod pa dang drug yod pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa bzod pa'i rtags gnyis yod de/ ston pa gzhan gyis lam ngan pa la bkri bar mi btud pa dang*/ me lnga brten pa sogs lam ltar bcos pa gzhan nye bar ston pa'i bdud yin pa la bdud ces bya bar rtogs pa dang gnyis yod pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa chos mchog gi rtags yod de/ sgo gsum gyi spyod pa thams cad sangs rgyas dges pa ste dgyes pa'i spyod pa zhes bya ba thob pa gcig dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /don bsdu ba ni/ sngar bshad pa'i rtags ni nyi shu po de dag gis byang sems sbyor lam pa dbang rnon rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par shes par bya ste/

drod dang rtse mo dang bzod pa bcas pa dang chos mchog rnams la gnas pa'i rtags ni sngar ltar shes par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mthong lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags bshad pa la/ mdor bstan pa dang rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ mthong ba'i lam la bzod pa dang*/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi gsungs/ don ni/ byang sems mthong lam pa dbang 'bring gi rgyud kyi mthong ba'i lam bzod pa dang shes pa'i skad cig ma bcu drug gis bsdus pa'i char gtogs pa'i thabs shes khyad par can dang bcu drug po des drangs pa'i lus ngag gi tha snyad khyad par can 'khrul med brtan po gnyis ni chos can/ byang chub sems dpa' 'bring mthong lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i mtshan nyid de rtags yin par shes par bya ste/ de sgrub kyi tshul gsum yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gzugs sogs 'du shes ldog pa dang*/ zhes pa nas/ phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags dag yin/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/ mthong lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags bcu drug yod de/ shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug g-i ming can mthong lam pa'i lus ngag gi tha snyad khyad par can gzugs sogs la bden par 'du shes pa kun btags ldog pa dang*/ kun rdzogs dang don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems brtan pa dang*/ theg pa dman pa sems dag las rnam par ldog pa dang*/ bsam gtan dang la sogs te gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug gi dbang gis dbang med du skye ba'i rgyu'i nus pa'i yan lag yongs su zad pa dang bzhi ni sdug bden la dmigs pa'i rnam pa can dang*/ lus sems yang ba shin tu sbyangs pa'i bde ba khyad par can dang ldan pa nyid dang*/ zhen pa med par 'dod pa la spyod pa la thabs mkhas pa dang*/ rtag tu tshangs par spyod pa nyid dang*/ 'tsho ba'i yo byad rnam par dag pa nyid dang bzhi ni kun 'byung bden pa la brten pa'i rnam pa can dang phung po la sogs pa ste khams dang skye mched la dang po dang rjes su bden par zhen pa'i sbyor ba bkag pa dang*/

bar chad byed pa'i mi mthun phyogs rnams la sngar ltar bden par sbyor ba bkag pa dang*/ sbyin sogs kyi tshogs la sngar ltar sbyor ba bkag pa dang*/ mdo las grong khyer gyi sgras bstan pa mig gi dbang po sogs dbang rten dang grong rdal gyi sgras bstan pa dbang yul rnams dang bcas pa yi yul yul can la spang gnyen gyi g.yul 'gyed pa la snga ma bzhin sbyor ba bkag pa bzhin ni 'gog pa la brten pa'i rnam pa can dang*/ ser sna dang tshul 'chal la sogs pa la dang por bden par sbyor ba dang rjes su bden par sbyor ba yi gnas pa so sor bkag pa dang*/ lam dang 'bras bu'i chos ni don dam par sdug bsngal tsam yang mi dmigs pa nyid dang ldan pa dang*/ byang sems rang gi sa la the tshom dang bral bar gnas pa nges pa nyid kyis mkhyen gsum gyi bdag nyid dang rang gis thob pa'i sa gsum la ni gnas pa dang ldan pa dang*/ rnam mkhyen sogs thob bya'i chos kyi don du srog gtong ba la ser sna dang sdug bsngal mi 'byung ba bzhi ni lam bden la dmigs pa'i rnam pa can rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ de 'dra'i skad cig ma bcu drug po ni chos can/ blo ldan byang sems mthong lam pa'i lam la gnas pa de rnams kyi phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags dag yin te/ rgyu mtshan sngar bshad pa de'i phyir/ 'dir phyir mi ldog pa'i don yod de/ lam gzhan gyi bar ma chod par bla med byang chub tu 'gyur nges de de'i don yin pa'i phyir/ don de tshang pa tsam gyis phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags thob pas ma khyab ste/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya yin na de yin dgos pa'i phyir/ theg chen gyi mthong lam skad cig ma bcu drug po de phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags ma yin te/ byang sems mthong lam rnam grol lam pa ba yin na/ de thob pas khyab pa'i phyir dang*/ rang las rtogs pa dma' bas mngon sum du nges mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa sgom lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags bshad pa la/

sgomalam rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ sgom lam gyi khyad gzhi/ khyad chos/ dbye ba bshad pa dang gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ sgom pa'i lam ni zab pa ste/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi gsungs/ don ni/ theg chen sgom lam bar chad med lam ni chos can/ zab pa yin te/ rang gi gnas lugs zab mo stong pa nyid la sogs pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'i yul can yin pa'i phyir/ stong pa nyid de ni chos can/ zab pa yang yin te/ sgro 'dogs dang skur pa 'debs pa'i mtha' las grol pa nyid kyi yul zab mo yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ nges 'byed yan lag dang mthong ba'i/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi gsungs/ don ni/ theg chen gyi sgom lam chos can/ rgyun chags su gnas pa yin te/ theg chen gyi nges 'byed yan lag dang mthong ba'i lam dang sgom pa'i lam nyid la rang gi mthong ba'i don mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa la thos sogs kyis yang dang yang du sems pa dang*/ tshad mas 'jal ba dang*/ zhib tu nges par rtogs pa'i sgom pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ da ni rgyun chags yin pa'i phyir/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi gsungs/ 'di la dngos dang*/ rtsod pa spong pa gnyis/ dang po'i don ni/ theg chen sgom lam de ni chos can/ rnam pa dgur bzhed de/ khyod la der gyur ba'i chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po rnams su yod cing de re re 'ang chung ngu'i chung ngu sogs te chung ngu'i 'bring dang chung ngu'i chen po dang*/ 'bring dang chen po la'ang de ltar dbye ba yis rnam pas de bzhin du yod pa'i phyir/ rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyod rgyun chags su 'byung ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la/ dbye ba'i rtsod spong dang*/ grangs nges gyi rtsod spong dang*/ byed las la rtsod pa spong ba gsum/ dang po la/ rtsod pa dang*/ lan bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ theg chen gyi sgom lam la rnam pa dgur grangs nges pa mi 'thad par thal/ sgom lam dang de'i bsod nams grangs med par mdo las bshad pa'i phyir zhe na/

gnyis pa ni/ grangs med la sogs bstan pa rnams/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/ yum gyi mdo las sgom lam gyi 'bras bu bsod nams grangs med la sogs pa bstan pa rnams ni dam pa'i don du ste don dam par dbyer bzod pa ma yin yang*/ kun rdzob tu 'bras bu de ltar 'byung ni sangs rgyas nyid kyis thugs brtse ba'i rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu bstan pa de dag thub pa rang nyid bzhed pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la/ don dam la ltos pa'i rtsod pa dang*/ tha snyad la ltos pa'i rtsod pa gnyis/ dang po la/ rtsod pa dang*/ lan gnyis dang po ni/ dngos po brjod du med pa la/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi gsungs/ don ni/ theg chen gyi sgom lam zhes bya'i lam kyis ni chos can/ spang bya ci zhig nyams shing gnyen po ci zhig thob pa mi 'thad par thal/ don dam par ma grub pa'i phyir khyab ste/ sgom lam gyi dngos po don dam par brjod du med pa la spang bya nyams pa dang gnyen po 'phel pa'i rnam gzhag mi rung ba'i phyir zhe na/ gnyis pa lan ni/ byang chub ji lta de bzhin du/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can don dam par spang gnyen 'phel 'grib med kyang*/ spang gnyen mi 'thad pa'i skyon med par thal/ bla med byang chub kyi ye shes de don dam par med kyang tha snyad du gdul bya'i don byed pa ji lta ba de bzhin du sgom lam 'di ni don dam par med kyang tha snyad du spang bya la gnod pa la sogs pa'i 'dod pa'i don sgrub par byed pa'i phyir/ dpe don mi mtshungs pa'i skyon med par thal/ de gnyis tha snyad du bya ba byed nus par mtshungs shing*/ byang chub don dam par med pa de bzhin nyid kyi mtshan nyid can yin pa de ltar sgom lam de yang de yi mtshan nyid can du bzhed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ rtsod pa dang*/ lan no/ /dang po ni/ sems ni snga mas byang chub par/ /rigs min phyi mas kyang ma yin/

/zhes gsungs/ don ni/ byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems ni chos can/ rang 'bras rdzogs pa'i byang chub bskyed par mi rigs par thal/ khyod skad cig snga ma kho nas rang 'bras rdzogs pa'i byang chub bskyed pa ni rigs pa ma yin la/ skad cig phyi ma kho nas kyang bskyed nus pa rigs pa ma yin zhing*/ cig car rim can gyis kyang de ltar rigs pa ma yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ gnyis pa lan ni/ mar me'i dpe yi tshul gyis ni/ /zab mo'i chos nyid rnam pa brgyad/ /ces gsungs/ don ni/ sems bskyed pa skad cig snga phyi mang po rim gyis 'byung bas rang 'bras byang chub mi bskyed pa'i skyon med par thal/ mar me skad cig snga ma las phyi ma nus ldan du rim gyis 'byung bas sdong bu snun ldan rdzogs par sreg par byed pa'i mar me'i dpe'i tshul gyis ni/ sems bskyed snga phyi rim gyis 'byung bas rang 'bras sku gsum bskyed pa'i phyir dang*/ zab mo'i chos nyid rnam pa brgyad po 'chad pa 'di rnams kyang khong du chud par 'gyur pa'i phyir ro*/ /gnyis pa rtags ni/ skye ba dang 'gag pa dang*/ zhes sogs rkang ba bzhi gsungs/ /don ni/ sa brgyad pa chos can/ zab mo rnam pa brgyad thugs su chud pa dang ldan te/ gzhi'i gnas lugs skye ba'i rten 'brel zab pa dang*/ 'gag pa zab pa dang*/ spyod pa nyams len gyi de bzhin nyid zab pa dang*/ sbyin sogs don dam par med kyang kun rdzob tu yod pa'i shes bya zab pa dang*/ chos thams cad spros bral du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i yul can gyi shes pa zab pa dang*/ don dam par med kyang tha snyad du spyod pa zab pa dang*/ mtshan ma dang de med pa gnyis ka don dam par gnyis su med par rtogs pa'i zab pa dang*/ 'bras bu mngon du byed pa'i thabs mkhas pa la zab pa nyid dang ldan pa'i phyir/ gsum pa sku gsum 'grub byed kyi sbyor ba khyad par can bshad pa la/

chos sku sgrub byed srid zhi mnyam nyid sbyor ba dang*/ longs sku sgrub byed zhing dag sbyor ba dang*/ sprul sku sgrub byed thabs mkhas sbyor ba bshad pa gsum/ dang po ni/ chos rnams rmi lam 'dra ba'i phyir/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi gsungs/ 'di la dngos dang*/ klan ka spang pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ sa brgyad pa'i ye shes chos can/ srid zhi mnyam nyid sbyor ba yin te/ srid pa 'khor ba dang zhi ba mya ngan las 'das par don dam par rnam par mi rtog par 'khor 'das bden stong mnyam pa nyid du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i dag sa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ 'khor 'das kyis mtshon pa'i chos rnams don dam par med kyang tha snyad tsam du grub pa rmi lam dang 'dra bar rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i dag sa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la/ klan ka dang*/ de'i lan no/ /dang po ni/ nyin par dge mi dge las gsog pa byed pa med par thal/ chos thams cad don dam par ma grub par tha snyad du rmi lam dang 'dra ba'i phyir/ zhe na/ gnyis pa lan ni/ shes bya chos can/ ji skad bshad pa'i klan ka de mi 'jug par thal/ las med du thal ba la sogs pa'i klan ka de yi lan ni yum gyi mdo las ji skad bshad zin par zad pa de'i phyir/ mdo las gsungs tshul yod de/ las gsog pa mdzad par thal ba dang*/ las 'bras don dam par med par thal ba dang*/ lung dang 'gal bar thal ba dang*/ rmi lam du las gsog pa mi 'thad pa'i klan ka bzhi dang lan bzhi gsungs pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ rab 'byor byang chen gyis rmi lam du las gang gis byas pa'i las de la gsog pa dang bri bar 'gyur ram/ zhes bkod nas/ lan ni/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu ji ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis chos thams cad rmi lam lta bur gsungs pa de ltar na zhes sogs kyis bstan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ nyin par srog bcad pa dang rmi lam du srog bcad pa de la 'di snyam du de bdag gis bsod legs par bsod do shin tu bsad do zhes sad de rnam par rtog na zhes sogs bkod nas/

lan ni/ rab 'byong dmigs pa med par las mi skye ste las ni dmigs pa dang bcas pa kho nar skye'o zhes sogs kyis bstan pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grub ste/ rab 'byor las thams cad dang sems pa thams cad dben pa'o zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pas ji ltar dmigs pa dang bcas par las skye zhes sogs bkod nas/ lan ni/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu mtshan mar byas na dmigs pa dang bcas par las skye ste zhes sogs kyis bstan pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa grub ste/ rab 'byor gal te byang chen gyis rmi lam du sby-in pa byin/ zhes pa nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de bla na med par yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngos na zhes sogs bkod nas/ lan ni/ shā ri'i bu byang chen byams pa skye ba gcig gis thogs pa 'di la dris zhig zhes sogs kyis bstan pa ltar yin pa'i phyir/ rmi lam du dge mi dge'i las byed par rmis nas sad pa'i tshe mngon zhen gyis dga' ba sgom na las de las 'bras bu bde sdug 'byung ba srid kyang*/ rmi lam gyi mi de mi ma yin pas srog gcod kyi las lam dngos gzhi med de/ de bzhin du rmi lam du sbyin pa btang ba rmongs pa sogs la yang las lam gyi dngos gzhi rdzogs pa med pa'i phyir/ 'o na/ gnyid de dge mi dge gang yang min nam zhe na/ min te gnyid gzhan 'gyur yin pas de dang dge ba'i gzhi 'thun dang*/ mi dge ba'i gzhi 'thun dang*/ lung ma bstan yang yod pa'i phyir/ dang po yod de/ rmi lam du dkon mchog gsum la dad gus byed pa yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yod de/ rmi lam du srog gcod byed pa'i rmis pa yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa yod de/ gnyid dus dran med du 'gyur ba yod pa'i phyir/ srid zhi mnyam nyid ces gsungs pa ni de gnyis bden stong du mtshungs pa'i don yin gyi/ srid zhi gnyis mnyam pa nyid du 'dod mi rung ste/ gzhan du na 'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid dang*/ bzang ngan yang mnyam pa nyid du 'gyur bas ha cang thal ba'i phyir ro/

/gnyis pa zhing dag sbyor ba ni/ sems can 'jig rten de bzhin du/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi gsungs/ don ni/ sa brgyad pa'i ye shes chos can/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing ni dag pa nyid kyi sbyor ba yin te/ bcud kyi sems can 'jig rten ma dag pa rnams dag par sgrub par byed pa de bzhin du/ snod kyi 'jig rten yang ma dag pa de la dag par sgrub pa yi dge rtsa mthu can du gyur pa'i dag sa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa thabs mkhas sbyor ba ni/ yul dang sbyor ba can 'di ni/ zhes pa nas/ thabs la mkhas pa rnam pa bcu/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni rnam thar sgo gsum sogs sher phyin gyi yul dang yul can du dus dang dus ma yin par sbyor ba la mkhas pa can gyi dag sa'i ye shes 'di ni chos can/ khyod la thabs la mkhas pa'i sbyor ba rnam pa bcu yod de/ phung po'i bdud la sogs pa'i bdud bzhi'i/ dgra ci rigs las rnams las ni 'das pa'i thabs mkhas sbyor ba dang*/ chos thams cad la don dam par mi gnas par tha snyad du spyod pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ gzhan gyi don sngon gyi smon lam ji bzhin shugs kyis 'phangs pa'i byed pa can gyi sbyor ba dang*/ nyan rang dang thun mong ma yin pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi dka' spyad goms pa dang*/ chos thams cad la bden zhen gyis ma chags pa dang*/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid gyis 'dus byas thams cad kyi ngo bo don dam par mi dmigs par rtogs pa dang*/ mtshan med kyi rgyu'i mtshan ma don dam par med par rtogs pa dang*/ smon med kyis 'bras bu la don dam par smon lam zad par rtogs pa dang*/ rang nyid phyir mi ldog pa yin pa de yi rtags khyad par can dang ldan pa dang rigs pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i rtogs pa tshad med pa zhes bya ba'i thabs mkhas sbyor ba dang bcu yod pa'i phyir/ sbyor ba de gsum ldog pa'i sgo nas bzhag pa yin gyi/ 'gal ba ni ma yin te/ dag sa'i ye shes yin na/

de gsum ka yin dgos pa'i phyir te/ de gsum lag rjes 'jog tshul tha dad pa tsam gyi sgo nas bzhag pa'i phyir te/ chos sku longs sku sprul sku gsum sgrub byed kyi lag rjes tha dad pa tsam gyis bzhag pa'i phyir te/ sa brgyad pa nas bden 'dzin mngon 'gyur ba spangs shing mi rtogs ye shes la goms pa dbang bsgyur thob pas de gsum gyi lag rjes khyad par can 'jog nus par mtshungs pa'i phyir/ 'dir bdud bzhi'i khyad par yod de/ zag bcas nyer len gyi phung po lnga phung po'i bdud rags pa dang*/ nyon sgrib thams cad nyon mongs pa'i bdud rags pa dang*/ lha'i bu dga' rab dbang phyug lha'i bu'i bdud rags pa dang/ las nyon gyi dbang gis srog dbang 'gag pa'i cha de 'chi bdag gi bdud rags pa yin la/ ma rig bag chags kyi sa dang zag med kyi las kyi dbang gis skye ba blangs pa'i phung po'i bdud phra mo dang*/ ma rig pa'i bag chags phra mo de nyon mongs pa'i bdud phra mo dang lha'i bu'i bdud phra mo gnyis ka dang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'chi 'pho byed pa'i cha de 'chi bdag gi bdud phra mo yin pa'i phyir/ bdud bzhi lam gang gi gnas skabs su bcom tshul yod de/ theg pa che chung gi dbang du byas na/ theg dman dgra bcom gyi go 'phang dang sa brgyad pa thob nas nyon mongs pa'i bdud rags pa ci rigs bcom/ theg dman gyi mthong lam dang sbyor lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags thob nas lha'i bu'i bdud rags pa bcom/ theg dman gyi lhag med myang 'das dang theg chen gyi mthong lam thob nas phung po'i bdud rags pa dang 'chi bdag gi bdud rags pa gnyis ka bcom pa'i phyir/ bdud bzhi ma lus par bcom pa dang sangs rgyas pa gnyis dus mnyam pa yin te/ tshigs gsal las/ khyod kyis byang chub pa dang kho nar bdud bzhi bcom pa lags/ zhes pa dang*/ rnam bshad las kyang*/ bdud bzhi ma lus par bcom pa ni sangs rgyas pa kho na'o/

/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ ces pa 'di yang bshad sgrub ming can gyis bgyis pa ste/ phyis gnas brtan bkra shis dar rgyas kyis grwa tshang nang tu rab 'byams pa'i mtshan gdags mdzad pa'i tshe spar tu bsgrub pa'o// //madga lam/ /
